objective: Repeat #284 while independently monitoring host realtime-minus-monotonic offset; isolate solver-time telemetry without changing the health gate or publishing control.

clock_source_basis.source_observation: Ceres Solver::Solve computes total_time_in_seconds as WallTimeInSeconds() minus the start sample; the Linux upstream WallTimeInSeconds implementation calls gettimeofday. A backwards realtime adjustment during Solve can therefore produce a negative elapsed value.
clock_source_basis.qualification: This describes a plausible mechanism; #284 did not record CLOCK_REALTIME or CLOCK_MONOTONIC, so it does not prove that a clock step caused that sample.

interpretation: The non-reproduction plus stable sampled host-clock offset is consistent with, but does not prove, a one-off realtime clock step in #284. The run cannot retrospectively establish the #284 clock state. Keep the current fail-closed gate unchanged until an instrumented repeat or monotonic telemetry comparison resolves the source.
qualification: Planner-only diagnostic; no trajectory execution, PX4 control, runtime truth source, or GOAL C/D/E/F acceptance.
